name: living-resume
description: Peter A. Lilley — living resume (Vite + React Three Fiber + Express + local Ollama)

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @living-resume/api" "npm run dev -w @living-resume/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @living-resume/web && npm run build -w @living-resume/api
scripts.build:pages: npm run resume:pdf && npm run build -w @living-resume/web
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n api,web,tunnel -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @living-resume/api" "npm run dev -w @living-resume/web" "node scripts/start-tunnel.mjs"
